source.title: Certain comments on V. Szebehely’s paper ‘Open problems on the eve of the next millennium’.

trace.notes: Normalized the zbMATH URL to the exact reviewed work and recovered DOI 10.1023/A:1022594801657 from the zbMATH record.
No readable exact-work PDF or HTML full text was recovered. The DOI landing page was a Springer preview/paywalled landing page, and OpenAlex reported closed access with no repository full text.
Failed the source adequacy gate because only bibliographic metadata and access-status information were available, not the technical source text containing problem statements.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-2014971.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
